## About me

Hello! I am **Xueying Jia**, a Master of Public Health student in Epidemiology at **Columbia University Mailman School of Public Health**, pursuing a certificate in Applied Biostatistics and Public Health Data Science.

I earned my bachelor's degree in Food and Nutritional Sciences from **Macao University of Science and Technology**. My experience spans clinical nutrition, public health research, and data analysis.

Through [P8105](https://p8105.com), I am developing skills in data cleaning, visualization, and reproducible analysis with R.

## My background

My work has included birth-defect surveillance, a retrospective study of dietary interventions for obesity, and internships in public health and clinical nutrition.

Read more about my education, research, and professional experience on my [resume page](resume.html).
